reason: I might forward a few transfer screenshots to try the free 30, but my build doesn't make enough paperwork to justify another monthly bill. The screenshots already sit in the group chat, and I can copy the totals into my own sheet on a Sunday for free.
objection: If something gets paid twice, that is my site manager's problem, and a bot flagging it from abroad doesn't fix the person. I'd be paying $19 a month for a tidier spreadsheet, not for fewer mistakes or more trust in who I'm paying.
would_change_my_mind: Catching a real overcharge or double payment on my build during the free trial, one big enough to cover a year of the fee, and then paying per document only in the months I actually use it.
